items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Right after the war I got him, he had one of the most beautiful tones you ever want to hear. That’s what put me over.

ctx.x: He was a heavy — he’s from St. Louis originally. Right after the war I got him, he had one of the most beautiful tones you ever want to hear. That’s what put me over. He had that beautiful tone. So when I played for — see before I sat and played a lot of these black bands were playing a lot of loud sound — blah blah blah blah. And I came around with this stuff that people danced together, smooth or something, with the right tone and everything, and things change you know, the people could dance together. And I…
Oh my. And here’s Eddie Alley Day in San Francisco.
